candidate.raw_translation: Siffofin siffar fuska su ne nau'ikan siffar da ba'a sani ba, ba kuma bayanai na likita ko na lissafi. Hanyoyi na auna da bambancin halitta na iya canza sakamakon; bambance-bambancen da aka hada ba za su dace da wani nau'i guda ba. Kayan aikin yana amfani da adadin da ka shigar kawai kuma ba ya samun damar kamara ko adadin adadin da aka ajiye.
candidate.source: Face-shape labels are informal style categories, not medical or identity information. Measurement technique and natural variation can change the result; mixed proportions may not fit a single category. The tool uses only numbers you enter and does not access a camera or store measurements.
